Project.title: Photo Shoot Project
Project.description: Represents a photography and photo editing project for a client, synced with a Drive folder

clientEmail.description: Email address of the client matching their auth login

clientPhone.description: Contact phone number of the client

projectName.description: Name or concept of the photo shoot project

status.description: Current workflow status of the project editing

driveFolderId.description: Google Drive Folder ID containing the proofs images

selectedDriveFolderId.description: Google Drive Folder ID where approved/selected photos are directed or copied

deliveredDriveFolderId.description: Google Drive Folder ID containing the finalized delivered photos (03 - EDITADAS)

deliveredCount.description: Number of final edited photos delivered so far

deliveryNotes.description: Notes or delivery message from the photographer regarding partial or final delivered files

deliveryEstimate.description: Estimated delivery date of the final edited photos

selectedCount.description: Number of photos approved by the client

totalCount.description: Total number of proof photos in the gallery

adminNotes.description: Private notes or details compiled by the photographer

priceEstimate.description: Total estimate price or budget of the shoot

contractedCount.description: Number of included photos in the contracted package

extraPhotoPrice.description: Price per additional selected photo beyond the package

bonusPhotosCount.description: Number of complimentary or gift photos provided to the client for free

clientFinalNotes.description: General observations or batch delivery instructions provided by client upon finalizing selection

sessionDate.description: Actual date the photoshoot session took place

sessionValue.description: Total value paid for the photoshoot session to calculate 25% cashback

referralCode.description: Custom or auto-generated VIP referral and cashback code

referredByCode.description: The referral code of the client who referred this project

referralCreditsTotal.description: Total accumulated VIP cashback credits in R$ from own session and referrals

referralCreditsUsed.description: Amount of VIP credits already used towards shoots

referralCount.description: Number of friends referred who closed photoshoot sessions

Proof.title: Proof Image
Proof.description: Single image proof from the photoshoot representing options for user selection

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID of the image

thumbnailUrl.description: URL of the thumbnail image representation

fullUrl.description: Direct URL or proxy link to download the high-res proof design

status.description: Selection level status assigned by user

clientNotes.description: Observations or requests written by the client for this specific photo editing

isSelected.description: True if the image contains selection approval

isBonus.description: True if the photographer selected this photo as a complimentary gift

bonusNote.description: Message from the photographer explaining why this photo was gifted

Notification.title: Notification Event
Notification.description: Status logging or in-app push-notification triggered automatically on changes

message.description: Detail information of the status change or comments

read.description: True if the user has dismissed/marked this notification

recipientEmail.description: Email address of the intended recipient (client or admin)

DeliveredProof.title: Delivered Final Edited Photo
DeliveredProof.description: Final edited high-resolution photo delivered from 03 - EDITADAS folder with AI prompts and usage tips

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID of the final image

fullUrl.description: Direct URL or proxy link to download high-res file

batchType.description: Whether this photo was delivered as part of a partial batch or final completion

creativeNotes.description: Styling, composition and lighting notes provided by Dilson Ferreira

downloadUrl.description: Direct download link for high resolution file

deliveredAt.description: Timestamp when the file was delivered

projects/{projectId}/proofs.description: Subcollection of picture proofs matching the shoot

projects/{projectId}/delivered.description: Subcollection of final edited delivered photos from 03 - EDITADAS

projects/{projectId}/notifications.description: Subcollection of notifications related specifically to the project
